fato_historico: 2007: Calder Hall, the world's first commercial nuclear power station, is demolished in a controlled explosion.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to release old structures that no longer serve your growth. Just as the towering monuments of the past gracefully clear the horizon to make space for the future, you may find it is a good time to clear your mental clutter. Consider this a fresh start for your most grounded aspirations.
frase_do_dia: Sometimes letting go is the most beautiful way to build something new.
significado_numero: The number of intuition and finding harmony within new beginnings.
conselho: Clear away what is outdated to allow fresh luck to find you today.
